title: Add the doc-center print-template migration preset so its registry entry leaves dataset-ready
description: Stage 2 registry gap: the 'print-template:doc-center' registry entry (DatasetKey 'trade-document', Supported=true) reaches only dataset-ready because ReportConfigurationPresetManifest.Presets has no preset keyed to 'print-template:doc-center' — the trade-document presets are keyed 'document:trade-document-print' and 'document:trade-document-export-excel' only (ReportConfigurationPresetCatalog.cs:279-289). ReportMigrationPresetCatalog.HasPresetAsync matches strictly by LegacyKey (ReportConfigurationPresetCatalog.cs:865-872), so the doc-center print-template entry can never reach preset-ready/parity-passed and keeps the legacy doc-center print route from retiring. Add a preset keyed 'print-template:doc-center' with DatasetKey 'trade-document' reusing the existing TradeDocumentPrintPresetDefinition(), preserving fail-closed behavior (never parity-passed without four-dimension evidence). No new controller/designer/exporter, no arbitrary SQL, no schema/seed/migration changes, no secrets/env, no permission expansion; only the preset manifest plus regression tests. Not audit-only: it unblocks correct parity derivation for the migrated doc-center print-template entry.
acceptance_criteria: ReportConfigurationPresetManifest.Presets contains a preset with LegacyKey 'print-template:doc-center' and DatasetKey 'trade-document' reusing the existing trade-document print definition, so HasPresetAsync('print-template:doc-center') returns true.

The 'print-template:doc-center' registry entry advances from dataset-ready to preset-ready when its doc-center menu authorization and the trade-document dataset are present, never reaches parity-passed without complete four-dimension evidence, and existing 'document:trade-document-print' / 'document:trade-document-export-excel' presets and parity derivation remain unchanged and fail-closed.

Add/update executable unit coverage asserting the doc-center print-template preset is registered and the entry reaches preset-ready, with no regression in the existing print-template and document-quality migration tests. Run related tests plus the safe Release build/unit suite and scheduler self-test/contracts.
implementation_evidence: src/ERP.Application/Services/ReportConfigurationPrintTemplateCatalog.cs:112-120 adds doc-center with Supported=true and DatasetKey=ReportConfigurationConstants.DatasetTradeDocument; :37-49 derives LegacyKey 'print-template:doc-center'. src/ERP.Application/Services/ReportConfigurationPresetCatalog.cs:279-289 registers trade-document presets only under 'document:trade-document-print'/'document:trade-document-export-excel', never 'print-template:doc-center', so ReportMigrationPresetCatalog.HasPresetAsync (ReportConfigurationPresetCatalog.cs:865-872) returns false for 'print-template:doc-center'. src/ERP.UnitTests/ReportConfigurationPrintTemplateCatalogTests.cs:696-705 exercises the print-template registry entries without any doc-center preset, leaving the entry at dataset-ready.
